description: 1. Read SKILL.md to discover the ~/neet/ directory schema (profile.md, subjects/, sessions/, mocks/, flashcards/). Create the full directory tree. 2. Parse student_info.txt and create ~/neet/profile.md with Priya's category (OBC), state (Rajasthan), target score (620+), exam date (May 2025), and user type (dropper). 3. Parse mock_exam_attempt.txt and apply NEET's proprietary scoring: +4 per correct, -1 per wrong, 0 per unattempted. Calculate Physics=87, Chemistry=96, Biology=182, Total=365/720. Explicitly reference negative marking. 4. Store the analysis in ~/neet/mocks/mock_07_analysis.md with subject-level and total scores. 5. Using study_time_log.txt, compute ROI (errors per hour or marks-per-hour) for each weak chapter — not just raw error count — to identify high-priority focus areas (e.g., Ray Optics has 3 errors in only 3 hours = high ROI to fix). Reference ROI/priority language per SKILL.md's 'ROI-first' directive. 6. Create subject-level weak area files in ~/neet/subjects/. 7. Apply OBC category to college targeting — match score 365 to OBC cutoffs for AIIMS Jodhpur and Rajasthan government colleges. Note gap to target and which colleges are reachable. 8. Create at least one session log in ~/neet/sessions/.
